about: Cianwood Gym walked and played from a scratch copy of Paolo's chuck.sav (inside the door, four badges, six at level 48), the battle's seed fixed. goto: finds Black Belt Lung where he has wandered to -- (17, 3) in the one-tile corridor of row 3, blocking the way to his own (15, 3) -- and Lao, then Lung, spot the player on the way and are fought there. Nob is talked to: konefr's new team from 8cbe6ab86, a Hariyama at 43, the level checked, and a Machoke, 45 in his data but only its line read (his old one was a Machop and a Machoke at 25). Yoshi spots the player on the way to him. Then the winch at the top left, turned with A and a Yes, which stops the waterfall Chuck trains under (FLAG_SYS_CIANWOOD_WATERFALL_DISABLE; until then he only talks), and Chuck himself: his six beaten, the Storm Badge and TM01.
